left: {amount} is left to spend this month, about {perDay} a day.
over: Spending this month is {amount} over the budgets.
emptyText: A budget is how much you plan to spend on a category each month. This screen then shows how each one is going.
tapNote: Tap a category to see what was spent on it.
what: A budget is a spending limit you set for one category, like Groceries, each month.
sugNote: Worked out from what you spent in {months}, with a little extra room. Categories that are mostly bills are left out. Nothing is set until you choose it.
sugAsk: You usually spend about {amount} a month here. Set a monthly limit for it?
limitNote: Change the amount before you set it, if you like.
limitEdit: Type a new amount to change this budget.
